mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate weakening housing demand and reduced consumer activity, signaling an economic slowdown that depresses corporate profits and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with both HOUST and RSAFS declining, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC for PAYEMS in high unemployment falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with declining INDPRO, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units, it signals a sharp housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with HOUST < 1500.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL and decline in FEDFUNDS signals central bank response to inflation, creating market uncertainty that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS falling, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong economic expansion (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals loss of momentum that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong expansion with weakening consumer demand
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with GDPC1 > 3.0% and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for RSAFS in strong expansion falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
